title: Quarterly cadence and initiative gates for Private/VPC deliverables — stakeholder sync playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable quarter-level orchestration and decision playbook for Private/VPC/on-prem initiatives. Deliverables: (1) a stakeholder sync cadence (roles, frequency, templates), (2) explicit initiative gates and acceptance criteria tied to OKRs, (3) dependency matrix and upstream/downstream owner map, (4) risk register and mitigation playbook for staged rollouts. Goal is to reduce cross-team ambiguity and speed decisioning for Dedicated/Private milestones while preserving compliance controls.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published in Confluence with versioned sections and owner metadata
OKR mapping table linking each Private initiative to 1-2 measurable success metrics
Gates defined for alpha/beta/GA with clear exit criteria and required signoffs
Dependency matrix with owners for infra, runtime, console, legal, and sales; at least 90% of dependencies assigned
Runbook for rollback/fallback and security checklist for on-prem air-gapped customers included
updates: 2025-01-15: Kickoff with Eng, Security, Console, and Solutions. Aligned on scope; Security emphasized KMS/HSM gate as non-negotiable for GA.
2025-01-22: Drafted initial gates (alpha/beta/GA) and circulated to exec PMs for feedback. Key trade-off: strict gate increases time-to-GA but reduces regression risk for enterprise customers.
2025-01-30: Infrastructure owners (ENG-ops) requested explicit quant targets for latency and throughput behind each gate; added to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-03: Solutions engineering provided customer-driven scenarios (three enterprise customers) that must map to the dependency matrix; added contact owners and migration windows.

2025-02-05: Playbook structure approved in principle by PM leadership; next step: stitch into Console rollout runbook and schedule stakeholder cadence pilot in week of 2025-02-17. Assigned owner for Confluence publication: Jonah Reeves.
risks: Overly prescriptive gates delay smaller customers and increase churn risk for PLG users
Key infra metrics (p50/p99) not instrumented for private installs causing gate blocking
Legal/compliance review timelines vary by region and can push GA beyond target
Resource contention between Dedicated capacity work and Private on-prem packaging
mitigation_actions: Introduce a two-track gate: "core" vs "compliance" — customers can opt into compliance track post-GA
Add mandatory telemetry instrumentation task to infra backlog prior to alpha gate
Parallelize legal reviews by region; create region-specific checklist and required docs list
Reserve a small cross-functional "firebreak" squad (2 eng, 1 SRE, 1 PM) for critical unblock work during rollouts
decisions: Adopted gate structure: Alpha (core functionality, limited customers) -> Beta (broader usage with opt-in compliance features) -> GA (full compliance + SLA).
Require KMS/HSM integration signoff before GA for any customer opting into encrypted-at-rest mandates.
Pilot stakeholder cadence to be weekly 30min sync + bi-weekly deep technical review; reassess after two cycles.
next_steps: Publish initial playbook page and version it in Confluence (owner: Jonah Reeves) — target 2025-02-12
Run stakeholder cadence pilot week of 2025-02-17 (invite list from stakeholders field)
Create infra telemetry ticket and link to ENG-ops backlog; target to close before alpha gate
Coordinate with Legal to produce region-specific compliance checklists by 2025-02-28
Schedule canary Private deploy for two pilot customers in week of 2025-03-10 and capture metrics
